findings.title: Mutable attempt timestamps can select an older completed account label
findings.rationale: Both display queries now include completed CANCELLED mappings but select their label using ORDER BY ia.updated_at DESC, ia.id DESC. Cancellation updates that timestamp while preserving mapping evidence. Cancelling an earlier completed mapping after a newer successful reauthorization can therefore make the earlier username outrank the newer proven username. The BU/channel/resource/app-scope predicates establish ownership, but do not establish which mapping is newest. This is a distinct residual defect in the materially changed cancellation selector under SCOPE-07/DOD-06, rather than reopening the original missing-CANCELLED-label finding. The enclosed native case cancels only the newest mapping and does not exercise this ordering. No executed failure is claimed.
findings.suggested_action: Select the last completed mapping using durable mapping chronology or version ordering that cancellation cannot advance, retaining all existing ownership and app-scope predicates. Add a native case with two completed mappings, cancel the older one, and verify catalog/list/thread/reply-options retain the newer label with unchanged channel readiness and provider counters.
